canonical_data: the working tree and Git worktrees, AGENTS.md and GEMINI.md context files, .agents configuration and MCP definitions, and agent-produced artifacts, alongside interaction records Google retains service-side
current_repo_note: Google publishes google-antigravity/antigravity-cli as a README, changelog, and examples surface carrying no license and no operational source; the Python SDK is a separate Apache-2.0 repository queued as a candidate rather than folded into this record.
strengths: Artifacts make the reviewable unit a plan, diff, diagram, or browser recording that a person steers before files change, rather than a transcript read after the fact
One permission grammar over reads, writes, commands, URLs, and MCP calls covers the desktop app, the CLI, and five third-party editors from the same rules
Subagents can take an isolated Git worktree instead of the live workspace, and the browser subagent drives Chrome through a separate profile under a server-side denylist
weaknesses: The terminal sandbox is opt-in, still labelled Preview, and Google's own page states that none of the shipped presets turn it on; anything unsandboxed "runs on your host with full privileges"

The product terms carry no effective date, record every interaction by default, permit Google employees and contractors to review them, offer deletion only by emailing support, and make reaching the same account from any third-party client grounds for suspension

Google publishes enterprise controls it says do not work: admin browser URL allowlists are "currently being integrated and are not yet honored", and there is no security advisory or known-issues page for a tool that executes shell commands
The documentation contradicts itself on which models each tier gets, whether an organizational contract exists, and what the sandbox presets are called
why_it_matters: Google's consolidation of its consumer developer-agent line into one host-executing platform, and the clearest production example of agent output reviewed as artifacts rather than as chat.
